provenance.scope: Matched fictional-policy development comparison; no statistical significance or general safety claim.
provenance.pair_exclusion_rule: Compare only two annotated, decisive values for each dimension; absent annotations and unclear judgments are excluded separately. Required-point missing and contradicted statuses are decisive and unmet.
provenance.difference_definition: Candidate (grounded_without_conciseness) minus reference (grounded_with_conciseness) marginal rates in percentage points; review coverage can differ. Use paired counts for matched changes.
provenance.core_completion_denominator: Rows fully decidable on required points only; other dimensions have independent coverage.
provenance.statistical_significance: Not assessed; descriptive development comparison only.
